verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe manual operations (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget) invoked via API/CLI/MCP calls, but there is no evidence of a rules engine or event-trigger system where users can define conditions that automatically fire actions. Automation-depth here is unaddressed — missing for 10: any documented rule/trigger definition mechanism, event listeners, or conditional automation logic tied to ingestion/recall events.
